title: Crossing of the Düna
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Crossing of the Düna", at revision 1377273485, opens: "The Crossing of the Düna took place during the Great Northern War on 19 July 1701 near the city of Riga, present-day Latvia. The Swedish king Charles XII was in hot pursuit of king Augustus II the Strong of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Saxony. The crossing was easily made, and the coalition troops were quickly broken and retreated." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q826133, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1701 battle of the Great Northern War". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
